model.margin_formula: margin = 39.712 × (home net-EPA/play − away net-EPA/play) + -0.48; residual SD 13.23; R² 0.325; n = 137 completed 2026 games (weeks 1-10)
model.total_formula: total = 46.25 + 28.4 × (game sum of offense EPA/play); R² 0.377; n = 137
model.win_probability: Normal CDF with SD equal to the 2026 sample SD of game margins (13.23 points)
model.rest_adjustment: +0.25 points per day of rest differential (research convention; flagged, not fitted)
model.fit_data: nflverse 2026 schedules release (mirror of official NFL feed), weeks 1-10
model.market_reference_note: spread_line/total_line columns are archived market lines published by the nflverse schedules release — a SECONDARY source used only as a comparison, never as model input
